author: kycrafft
body:
o̶h̶ ̶g̶o̶d̶,̶ ̶n̶o̶t̶ ̶a̶g̶a̶i̶n̶

So many of you might have realized the nebula shop does not contain some of the most useful things, and when getting above 100 points there is little to spend on. These are just some ideas.

~~Warning~~: This page contains words, therefore may cause reading. You have been warned

Anyways back to my (4th or 5th) topic on this:

Spanky Spade
*Diamond shovel knockback 2. What did you really expect?
30 points
Level 30 needed

Spanky Spade Jr.
*Iron shovel, knockback 1
10 points
Level 10 needed

Bow
*Bow, power 1
35 points
Level 25 needed

Stone Pickaxe
*Stone pickaxe, unbreaking 1, efficiency 5 (Usefull for tunneling, ect)
20 points
Level 5 needed

Fire orb
*Magma cream, fire aspect 1, sharpness 2 (pretty much an upgrade to the fire torch)
30 points
Level 25 needed

Sniper Rifle
*Bow, punch 1, 30 durability, gives the user -30% speed
30 points
Level 35 needed

Golden Apples
*6 golden apples
12 points
Level 5 needed

Health potions
*Stack of 3 splash potions of healing 1
10 points
Level 10 needed

Wooden Axe
*Wooden axe, efficiency 2, unbreaking 2
8 points
Level 5 needed

Wood
*16 oak logs
4 points
Level 1 needed

Glass
*32 glass
8 points
Level 1 needed

Guardian's chestplate
*Gold chestplate, projectile protection 3, unbreaking 3, gives -10% speed
18 points
Level 20 needed

Fireworks
*64 Multicolored fireworks. Yay.
100 points
Level 1 needed

Judgement Axe
Gold axe, unbreaking 1, ignores ALL armor
15 points
Level 25  needed 

Shock Absorbers
*Gold boots, feather falling 2, unbreaking 1
10 points
Level 5 needed

Regeneration potion
*Potion of regeneration for 45 seconds
7 points
Level 5 needed

Death Mask
*Skeleton skull, thorns 2
20 points
Level 25 needed

Diamond Pickaxe
*Diamond pickaxe, efficiency 2
15 points
Level 10 needed

Ghost Essence
*Potion of invisiblity, nausea, mining fatigue 2 and slowness 2 for 20 seconds
30 points
Level 30 needed

Golem Essence
*Potion of resistance 2, slowness 1 and mining fatigue for 30 seconds
30 points
Level 30 needed

Haste Essence
*Potion of speed 1 and haste 1 for 30 seconds
30 points
Level 30 needed

Anchor Essence
*Splash potion of slowness 1 for 1:07 minutes
20 points
Level 30 needed

Powerful Bow
*Bow, power 2, gives weakness 1 fand slowness 1or 10 seconds while holdings it
40 points
Level 40 needed

replies.author: Bluecichlid
replies.body: Some nice suggestions. One thing, watch out for level specific items. They can lead to unbalanced and overpowered items which discourage other players from playing.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback guys. 

@Blue I feel that a level requirement gives players a goal to reach in nebula and in a way decreases the potential for them to be game changers by making them harder to obtain.  I've tried not to make things too overpowered also. Most of these things will not earn you back the points you spent.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
I intentionally made he items overpriced to prevent them from being overpowered. 

Geez the fireworks are for fun... If you've got nothing to do and have a lot of points, buy them. 

On some maps wood doesn't drop. I don't really what players to have a whole lot of wood on non-wood maps either (ex: titans). I'll lower the price though.
